description: The one privileged webview: the module bar and the selected module, loaded from the dev server or the tauri:// asset protocol. Note `webviews` and no `windows`: a capability that names a window grants every webview inside it, which would hand the whole command surface to the pages. Page webviews are named by no capability in c18 and so can call nothing; c19 gives them exactly one command of their own, in `page.json`.
